description: This PHP class defines a model, ClaimRequestSummaryModel, used in the OrangeHRM Claim API to represent a summary of a claim request. It implements the Normalizable interface and utilizes traits for serialization, encapsulating a ClaimRequest entity and exposing 'id' and 'referenceId' as its properties.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSummaryModel
classes.description: A model representing a summary view of a claim request, intended for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ClaimRequest entity and sets properties for serialization.
